name: Email Bombing

evidence.rationale: ATT&CK explicitly discusses DMARC, SPF, and DKIM on the Email bombing technique page, including how enabling these mechanisms within an organization (through policies such as DMARC) may enable recipients (intra-org and cross domain) to perform similar message filtering and validation to mitigate this technique.

This relationship applies when penetration testing identifies the described software configuration weakness and remediation of the finding strengthens mail service configuration, sender authentication policy, filtering, throttling, and related controls that reduce abusive high-volume email delivery.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
